verdict.rationale: Spending caps and budget alerts are a fair question for a pay-per-token inference cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents neither. Pay-as-you-go messaging ('no minimums', 'no surprises') and the fail_fast HTTP 429 option concern pricing structure and queueing, not configurable spend limits or alerts.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
